description: Move a deal to a pipeline stage by its id. Closed-lost stages require a lostReason. Use search_deals for the deal id and list_pipeline_stages for the target stageId. The result echoes the operating workspace.

id.description: The deal id returned by search_deals.

lostReason.description: Reason the deal was lost. Required when the target stage is a Closed-lost stage; otherwise omit.

stageId.description: The target pipeline stage id to move the deal to (from list_pipeline_stages).

name: transition_deal
title: Transition deal
